posts.coverText: Does your boyfriend actually pay attention? (No hints)

slideText.text: After a bad day, what do I want from you most?
options: let me vent without trying to fix it
show up with my favorite food
give me space until I'm ready

slideText.text: How can you tell I'm jealous, even when I say I'm not?
options: I suddenly want all your attention
I act like I couldn't care less

slideText.text: Which of these would make my whole day?
options: a date you planned without my help
a voice note telling me you miss me
you remembering something I mentioned once

slideText.text: When I say “It's fine,” what do I usually mean?
options: I'm hurt but don't want to argue
I need time before I can talk about it
I want you to notice I'm upset

slideText.text: Which of these bothers me most, even if I act like it doesn't?
options: you forgetting little things I've told you
you being on your phone during our dates
you not posting me on social media

posts.coverText: Make your boyfriend choose. No "both" allowed

slideText.text: My eyes or my lips?
The way I kiss you or the way I touch you?
My soft side or my wild side?
Me in your hoodie or me all dressed up for you?
Me being clingy or me playing hard to get?

posts.coverText: Guys, ask your girlfriend these 5 questions (don’t get defensive)

slideText.text: What was your honest first impression of me?
options: I thought you were a player

slideText.text: What surprised you most once we started dating?
options: You're softer than you let on
You get jealous more than you admit
You caught feelings before I did

slideText.text: What's something about me you didn't like at first but love now?
What's my biggest red flag as a boyfriend?
options: You shut down instead of talking
You joke when I'm being serious
You always need to be right

slideText.text: Knowing everything you know about me now, would you still choose me?
options: Yes, but I'd take things slower
Only if a few things changed

posts.coverText: Couples, is this normal or weird? No “it depends” 👀

slideText.text: Peeing while your partner is brushing their teeth right next to you.
Sharing a bed but not a blanket.
Being together for two years and still leaving the room to fart.
Being allowed to go through each other’s phones without asking first.
Splitting the bill 50/50 on every date, even if one of you makes way more money.

posts.coverText: If we woke up married tomorrow... would we survive? 💍

slideText.text: What's the first thing you'd call me?
options: Your actual name — I don't do pet names

slideText.text: Who's making breakfast on our first morning as newlyweds?
options: Me — you're getting breakfast in bed
My mom — she already invited us over

slideText.text: What would you expect to change once we're married?
options: No more trips without each other
We start trying for a baby
Nothing — marriage is just a piece of paper

posts.coverText: Ask your boyfriend: which one am I? No “Both.” 👀

slideText.text: Am I more of a princess or a boss?
options: boss — I like calling the shots

slideText.text: Am I the jealous type or the chill type?
options: chill — I don't get worked up over other girls

slideText.text: When we argue, am I more sensitive or stubborn?
options: sensitive — I take things to heart
stubborn — I always have to win

slideText.text: Am I more clingy or independent?
options: clingy — I want all your attention

slideText.text: Be honest: am I your peace or your biggest headache?
options: your peace — I make your life better
your biggest headache — I drive you crazy

posts.coverText: I’d marry you tomorrow... but these 5 answers might change my mind 💍

slideText.text: We just got married. Your ex texts, “Congrats ❤️.” What do you do?
options: Show you the text before replying.
Reply and catch up a little. We’re still friends.

slideText.text: It’s Friday night. We have date plans, but your friends invite you out. What do you do?
options: Stick to our plans. You’re my wife.
Ask if we can reschedule our date.
Invite you to come with us.
Go with them. We’re married, not attached at the hip.

slideText.text: Once we’re married, how are we handling money?
options: One shared account. Everything is ours.
Split everything 50/50, even if I earn more.
Split bills based on income. Whoever earns more pays more.
I cover the bills. Your paycheck is yours.

slideText.text: Our kid gets in trouble, and we disagree on the punishment. What do you do?
options: Back you up in front of them, then talk privately.
Step in if I think you’re being too harsh.
Let the stricter parent make the final call.
Skip the punishment. We should talk it out instead.

slideText.text: Your mom asks for a key to our place and says she shouldn’t have to call first. What do you say?
options: “You can have a key, but you have to text first.”

posts.coverText: Aww or eww? couples, no “it depends” 👀

slideText.text: Showering together when there’s barely enough room for one.
Using embarrassing pet names for each other in front of your friends.
Stealing sips of each other’s drinks without asking.
Falling asleep on FaceTime every night, even when you live 10 minutes apart.
Sharing your locations with each other 24/7.

posts.coverText: Couples, is this harmless or disrespectful? No “it depends” 👀

slideText.text: Your partner goes out to dinner with their ex, just the two of them.
Your partner sends screenshots of your arguments to their friends’ group chat.
Your partner goes on a weeklong vacation with their single friends. No partners allowed.
Your partner lets someone buy them a drink at a bar, knowing that person is hitting on them.
Your partner still won’t give you their phone passcode after two years together.
